name: Ski Caiso
description: Carve an endless, hand-painted mountain with rhythmic flow and stylish tricks. Master the pump mechanic, nail perfect landings, and activate Flow State for massive speed boosts!
author: CaisoGames AI Team

touch.description: Tap and hold to pump, swipe left/right for flips

features: Procedural terrain generation with sine wave synthesis
Perfect landing mechanic (match slope angle for speed boost)
Flow State combo system (consecutive perfects = invincibility + massive speed)
6 difficulty tiers with progressive obstacle introduction
Hand-drawn watercolor art style (Alto's Adventure inspired)
Parallax background layers with peaceful winter atmosphere

unique: Flow State Meter: Fill with perfect landings and tricks, activate for speed boost + invincibility

unlockables.name: Grind
unlockables.condition: Reach 3000 meters in a single run
unlockables.description: Land on fallen logs or rails to maintain speed and earn bonus points

unlockables.name: Glide
unlockables.description: Hold jump mid-air to deploy wingsuit and cross large chasms

tiers.name: Glacier Gap
tiers.description: High difficulty, large chasms requiring glide
